mapper.select: select device_id, entity_id, device_code, device_name, device_type, rated_capacity_kw, auto_yx_num, energized_yx_num, status, create_by, create_time, remark from vqms_art27_device where device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.insert: insert into vqms_art27_device (entity_id, device_code, device_name, device_type, rated_capacity_kw, auto_yx_num, energized_yx_num, status, create_by, remark) values (#{entityId}, #{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceType}, #{ratedCapacityKw}, #{autoYxNum}, #{energizedYxNum}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from vqms_art27_device where device_id in #{deviceId}
mapper.select: select id, stat_month, device_id, auto_hours, energized_hours, rate_penalty_days, nameplate_days, regulator_rate, regulator_penalty, source, create_by, create_time, remark from vqms_art27_month where stat_month = #{statMonth} order by device_id

select id, stat_month, device_id, auto_hours, energized_hours, rate_penalty_days, nameplate_days, regulator_rate, regulator_penalty, source, create_by, create_time, remark from vqms_art27_month where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into vqms_art27_month (stat_month, device_id, auto_hours, energized_hours, rate_penalty_days, nameplate_days, regulator_rate, regulator_penalty, source, create_by, remark) values (#{statMonth}, #{deviceId}, #{autoHours}, #{energizedHours}, #{ratePenaltyDays}, #{nameplateDays}, #{regulatorRate}, #{regulatorPenalty}, #{source}, #{createBy}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from vqms_art27_month where id in #{id}
